# owner: platform
from typing import List
from hourglass.schedule import worker_minutes
from hourglass.models import Shift
from hourglass.errors import ProjectError
from collections import Counter


def _check(shifts: List[Shift]) -> None:
    if not shifts:
        raise ProjectError("no shifts to total")
    for shift in shifts:
        if not shift.worker.strip():
            raise ProjectError("blank worker name")


def _line(name: str, counts: dict, minutes: dict) -> str:
    hours = f"{minutes[name] / 60:.1f}"
    return f"{name}: {counts[name]} shifts, {hours} hours"


def timesheet_lines(shifts: List[Shift]) -> List[str]:
    """One line per worker, most hours first."""
    _check(shifts)
    minutes = worker_minutes(shifts)
    counts = Counter(shift.worker for shift in shifts)
    rank = lambda name: (-minutes[name], name)
    order = sorted(minutes, key=rank)
    return [_line(name, counts, minutes) for name in order]
